text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT created: GPU capacity exhaustion + autoscaler stalled for inference pools. Priority: P1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-autoscale

alex: acked, i'm oncall. paged at 1783456789. looking now :mag:

maria: tagging runtime. any recent rollouts? saw a canary earlier for model-service v2.3 @eng-runtime

jordan: confirmed v2.3 rolled at 02:10 UTC to canary (10% traffic), ramped to 50% at 02:22 according to deploy-bot

alex: observed: long queues on gpu-serving pool, token gen latency spikes, lots of per-route throttles. GPUs show near-100% mem and no new nodes joined.

ryan: running quick queries to validate:

`````
sum(rate(inference_queue_length[1m])) by (pool)
sum(gpu_memory_used_bytes) by (instance)
`````

ryan: queue for pool=gpu-12 grew ~20 -> ~450 within ~8m. autoscaler attempted to scale_out but new pods stuck Pending with PVC bind/quota errors.

maria: runtime note: v2.3 enabled a larger default context (context_max=16384) and changed KV-cache prefetch. per-request KV working set ballooned. cold KV warmups + fragmentation likely pushed per-GPU memory over limits.

alex: controller logs show: "quotaExceeded: cannot attach more gpus in az-1 (hard limit)" and k8s events show FailedScheduling nodegroup-limit.

elaine: support report: some Dedicated customers seeing 429s. Sam, any customer impact numbers?

sam: pulling telemetry. preliminary: 3.4% of hosted requests had >5s tail latency and ~0.9% received 429s between 02:22-02:35. Affected high-alert customers: alpha-inc (high), beta-app (medium). Drafting comm to support.

jordan: autoscaler logs: it requested scale but cloud account p4d soft quota in us-west-2 hit. PD alert didn't fire upstream.

alex: immediate mitigations we can attempt now:
- rollback model-service to v2.2 to reduce KV working set
- enable routing fallback to small-model-1 for non-critical routes
- reduce context_max override for v2.3 traffic to 4096 via routing layer
- request manual scale from alternate region to provide spare GPUs
- throttle non-prod and batch routes temporarily

maria: prepping rollback patch: revert image -> model-service:v2.2 and disable kv-prefetch. need +1 to push now.

ryan: in parallel i'll evict caches and restart a subset of pods to defragment GPU memory:

`````
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-service -o wide
kubectl -n inference delete pod <pod> --grace-period=0
`````

ryan: also attempting manual autoscaler override to request additional GPU nodes (if cloud quota allows):

`````
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name asg-gpu-usw2 --desired-capacity 24
`````

alex: proceed with rollback @maria. i'll escalate quota with cloud-ops.

maria: rollback started, deploy logs: "starting redeploy model-service:v2.2". streaming.

incident-bot: Deploy started by maria at 1783456825. Watch: https://redwood.internal/deploys/6789

ryan: after deleting a few pods memory usage dropped ~35% on the busiest nodes, queue shrank 450 -> 120 in ~5m. good indicator.

elaine: support message ready for alpha-inc / beta-app: "We're mitigating a capacity regression introduced by a recent model rollout; rolling back now; ETA ~15m; will follow up with RCA." Approving send.

sam: customer comms sent.

jordan: cloud-ops ticket opened for quota bump: #CLD-4572. cloud team response: "increase in progress, ETA 40m".

alex: monitoring rollback results. if memory doesn't stabilize we will force a routing-level context cap as next mitigation.

maria: rollback finished at 1783456880. canary subset health checks passing.

ryan: metrics now: queue ~28 and dropping, GPU mem headroom ~10-15% on most pods, throttles decreasing.

alex: moving incident to mitigation. followups assigned:
- infra: verify quotas + setup cloud fallback / reserve pool (jordan)
- runtime: add guardrail to disallow huge default context_max without mem estimation (maria)
- oncall: monitor 2h and perform handoff at shift change (alex -> jordan)
- comms: post incident note + customer followups (sam/elaine)

participants: alex, maria, jordan, ryan, sam, elaine, incident-bot

jordan: I'll own the quota/fallback doc and lead the postmortem. taking incident lead for handoff window.

alex: handing off to jordan for next 2h monitoring at 1783456905. moving to watch. great work team :tada:

incident-bot: Incident updated: state=mitigated. handoff_ts=1783456905. Incident owner=jordan. Postmortem task created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1783456789/postmortem
